busy: AI is working… this can take up to a minute.
login.not_configured: No password is set yet. On the server, run:
notfound.title: This page doesn't exist.
today.title: Today
today.empty_text: Describe what you're promoting. Shade remembers it and prepares a plan, posts and daily tasks.
today.no_posts: No post is scheduled for today. Schedule one on a draft in a project.
today.reshare_text: You published these evergreen posts over a month ago. Get fresh versions and share them again.
cal.help: Scheduled drafts and published posts across all projects. Set the date on a draft.
form.intro: Fill this in once. AI uses it for every plan and post.
form.name: Project name
form.description: What does it do, and what makes it different?
form.description.placeholder: A few sentences, the way you'd explain it to a friend. The more specific, the better the output.
form.tone.placeholder: e.g. playful, honest, no corporate speak
form.voice.placeholder: Paste 2 to 5 posts you wrote and like.
form.voice.help: AI learns your writing style from them.
form.delete_confirm: Really delete the project with its plans and posts?
error.name: Enter a project name.
error.description: The description needs at least 20 characters.
error.url: That URL doesn't look right (it must start with https://).
error.refused: The AI declined this request. Try changing the brief.
error.truncated: The AI's answer was too long. Try again or with fewer channels.
error.invalid_output: The AI returned an invalid answer. Try again.
error.upstream: Couldn't reach the AI. Try again in a moment.
error.repurpose: Paste at least 20 characters and pick at least one channel and language.
flash.plan: Your new plan is ready. Tasks are scheduled and posts are in drafts.
flash.plan_demo: Plan created from a template (demo mode).
project.repurpose: One piece of content, many channels
plan.none: No plan yet. Generate one and the tasks spread over the next 4 weeks.
plan.note_ph: e.g. focus on the launch on March 15
plan.regenerate_help: A new plan replaces unfinished tasks. Completed tasks and published posts stay, and the AI builds on them.
ideas.placeholder: Jot down a post idea before you forget it…
ideas.none: No ideas yet. Each plan adds some too.
repurpose.help: Paste a devlog, update or announcement. AI turns it into posts tailored to each channel and language and saves them as drafts.
repurpose.placeholder: e.g. This week I added storms that reshape the island…
published.none: Nothing published yet. When you publish a post, mark it and log its results.
post.note_ph: e.g. lots of comments, 12 new wishlists
